scenes.script:
Rahul says: I am giving an English interview tomorrow.
Miss Nova says: Almost, Rahul! Say, I am appearing for an English interview tomorrow. Give ka matlab hota hai kuch hand over karna.
Rahul says: Ah, samajh gaya. You know, meri English actually bahut better ho rahi hai.
Miss Nova says: Very good! Aap itni achhi English bolna kahaan se seekh rahe ho?
Rahul says: Aap se hi, Supernova AI app par! Aap ho Miss Nova, meri personal AI teacher.
Rahul says: Mujhe achha lagta hai ki aap mujhe koi bhi random lessons nahi dete. Aapne mera exact level samajh kar mere liye ek personalized plan banaya hai.
Miss Nova says: Aur main aapki mistakes ko kabhi judge nahi karti.
Rahul says: Exactly! Is crowded train mein baithe-baithe main hazaaron mistakes kar sakta hoon, aur aap bina hase mujhe correct karti ho.
Miss Nova says: Kyunki aap actually out loud bol kar seekhte ho, sirf read karke nahi.
Rahul says: Haan. Log apne phone par ghanto feeds scroll karne mein waste karte hain, par main din mein bas 15 minutes aapke saath bolne mein spend karta hoon.
Miss Nova says: Sahi kaha. Daily practice se, yadatar learners ko lagbhag 1 month mein visible progress dikhne lagti hai.
